$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). The `default` keywords here are exactly the constant defaults of 8.3's and 8.4's tables (clearances, extensions, extras). A type's `layers`, `width`, `height` and `sill` have no default. The reference canonicalizer reads these keywords as its table of constant defaults (9.2 step 1).
title: Type
description: 8.1: a reusable definition that elements refer to instead of repeating — a wall assembly, a door or a window. A type MUST have a `kind` from 8.1's table (FS-CORE-8.1.1), and has only the members of that kind's table (FS-CORE-1.4.1).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 8.1: which kind of type this is.

wallType.title: Wall type
wallType.description: 8.3: a wall assembly, used by a wall's `type`.

layers.description: 8.3: the assembly, at least one layer (FS-CORE-8.3.1), from the wall's left (exterior) face to its right (interior) face. Always present.

name.description: 1.4, 8.1: a human-readable label, 1–200 characters. Absent by default.

doorType.title: Door type
doorType.description: 8.4: a door, used by an opening's `fill`.

width.description: 8.4: the width of every opening the type fills, unless the opening overrides it; when present, greater than zero (FS-CORE-8.4.1). Absent by default.

height.description: 8.4: likewise, the height; when present, greater than zero (FS-CORE-8.4.1). Absent by default.

sill.description: 8.4: likewise, the sill; when present, not negative (FS-CORE-8.4.1). Absent by default.

clearances.description: 8.4, 13.5: the clearance envelopes every opening this type fills needs kept clear, in the opening's frame (13.1).

name.description: 1.4, 8.1: a human-readable label, 1–200 characters. Absent by default.

windowType.title: Window type
windowType.description: 8.4: a window, used by an opening's `fill`.

width.description: 8.4: the width of every opening the type fills, unless the opening overrides it; when present, greater than zero (FS-CORE-8.4.1). Absent by default.

height.description: 8.4: likewise, the height; when present, greater than zero (FS-CORE-8.4.1). Absent by default.

sill.description: 8.4: likewise, the sill; when present, not negative (FS-CORE-8.4.1). Absent by default.

clearances.description: 8.4, 13.5: the clearance envelopes every opening this type fills needs kept clear, in the opening's frame (13.1).

name.description: 1.4, 8.1: a human-readable label, 1–200 characters. Absent by default.
